items.title: McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
items.summary: A former McDonald's worker calls on the firm to “change the way they treat younger employees” as a judge rules a legal case against the chain can go ahead.

items.title: COVID was allowed to spread with 'deadly speed' and failure on borders was 'missed opportunity'
items.summary: A lack of testing left the government "effectively blind" to COVID spreading across the UK, a report has found.

items.title: Leasehold system set to be scrapped in England and Wales
items.summary: The proposed Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill will also include capping ground rent at £250.

items.title: Putin vows to retaliate as Ukraine hits prized Crimea bridge for third time in four days
items.summary: Ukraine has launched a third aerial attack in four days on the Kerch Bridge - a vital link between Russia and Crimea - with Vladimir Putin vowing retaliation.

items.title: UK joins in GTA 6 frenzy as game becomes available worldwide
items.summary: The game, which was in development for 13 years, is set become one of the world's most popular entertainment products ever.

items.title: Three men charged with murder of man in Greater Manchester
items.summary: Three men have been charged with the murder of a man in Crumpsall in the north of Manchester.
